item.title: Indonesia’s Toll Roads Could Become Runways for Fighter Jets
item.description: Indonesia lacks the industrial capacity to build or maintain an aircraft carrier fleet—but it has thousands of islands across the South China Sea that fighter jets could operate from. item.title: Lockheed Martin Is Building a “Parasite” Drone for the US Navy
